values.note: No cancellation less than 14 days before the first night. No generators. Check-in after 1 pm; check-out 11 am (noon Sunday).

booking.source: https://cuyuna.checkfront.com/reserve/ ('For weekends, you must reserve both Friday & Saturday night.'; 'No generators are allowed.') + https://www.ci.cuyuna.mn.us/campground ('Reservations may not be canceled less than 14 days before the first reservation night'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Checkfront lists each of RV Sites 1-6 at $45.00 per night (quoted for 2027-06-15, all shown UNAVAILABLE, apparently not yet open). Rate per camping unit (one car, RV or tent) and 2 adults; extra cars, boats or tents are charged (no figure).

fees.source: https://cuyuna.checkfront.com/reserve/?start_date=2027-06-15&end_date=2027-06-16 (browser read) + https://www.ci.cuyuna.mn.us/campground ('Our rates are by camping unit, a camping unit is one car, RV, or tent and 2 adults. Children under 12 are free.'), read 2026-11-11

note: City of Cuyuna campground (Cuyuna Mountain Bike Campground) just south of downtown, beside the Cuyuna Lakes State Trail, with a pavilion, playground and bike pump track. --Claude
summary: City page + Checkfront read: 6 RV sites with 30/50-amp electric + 6 tent sites, shower, city water, dump; season 2026 May 8-Oct 19; $45 a night per RV site (2 adults, under-12 free); weekend 2-night minimum; reservable on Checkfront.
